item.title: Autophagy: how cells clean out their own "trash" — and what it has to do with longevity
item.description: In 2016 the Nobel Prize went to the discovery of the mechanism by which a cell takes apart its own damaged components and recycles them. This process slows with age.

item.title: What is geroscience: why slowing aging is science, not science fiction
item.description: Aging was long treated as one indivisible process. Over the last 15 years it's been broken down into specific, measurable molecular mechanisms.
